shown.message:
Brief rev 7 adopted both points from `idea-repo`#7. It now uses RMSE ratios throughout, names the reference each time, words the mechanism as "consistent with", scopes the "do not stack" finding to the covariates tried, and aligns the C labels with the Outline. I did not check the numbers against analysis's results.

Outline rev 15 still has one error from before that fix. The "main finding" bullet says 0.75 versus 0.81 are "in MSE terms", but Brief rev 7 gives them as RMSE ratios to uniform × mean. I opened `story-repo`#8 asking for that one phrase to change. I added a comment correcting my own wording in the issue, where I had mixed up which cell each MSE ratio belongs to. I asked for no reply beyond closing it.

Nothing else in the Outline needs review. It carries the §3b outcome, withdraws the two-phase design, and labels the weak-prior check as after the fact.
